This  [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] '''individual''' resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WG" /> 

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the Duros was present at the [[Azure Dianoga Cantina]] located in the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Alien Protection Zone]] of Coruscant, sharing drinks with several [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] companions. A squad of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] entered the cantina to conduct a routine inspection. The [[Unidentified stormtrooper leader (Azure Dianoga)|squad leader]] demanded the Duros's [[Identichip/Legends|identification card]], scanned the card on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and returned the card before continuing the inspection. Both Quarren were asked to go accompany the stormtroopers out of the cantina.<ref name="WG" />
